content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to use two analog inputs with two analog comparator blocks, where one comparator has a gain of 0.1 and the other has a gain of 0.06? If M1 is set, I want the gain to be 0.1, and if M2 is set, I want the gain to be 0.06. [user_name]
Hello [user_name], For example, open the block properties for the analog comparator. Use the arrows to select the required gain value on both comparators in the Gain parameter.

Hi [user_name], I've already tried that, but when I select analog comparator 2 and then go back to analog comparator 1, the gain value does not remain as set... You can check my file for details. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are troubleshooting how gain values are managed and switched in analog comparator blocks within [company_name] configuration software. The key issue is that changing between comparator blocks can result in gain settings not being retained, causing difficulty in achieving dynamic gain selection based on marker conditions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect each analog comparator to retain its individually set gain value and allow dynamic selection based on marker conditions such as M1 or M2.
